mechanism: Estradiol may increase meloxicam levels through CYP2C9 inhibition and displacement from protein binding, while meloxicam may reduce estradiol efficacy through enterohepatic circulation interference and increased GI bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for meloxicam toxicity (GI bleeding, cardiovascular events) and contraceptive efficacy; consider alternative NSAID or use lowest effective meloxicam dose with gastric protection.
